name: Tanlan Yu Kongju Ji Qita
source:
You are ready to say goodbye to life, but are you prepared to face your life's truth? Navigate a grad student's life between greed and fear in his final 6 hours (and beyond) in this BL visual novel.

This is part I of "The Mind Deceivers" Trilogy.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2514650/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你已经准备好告别生活，但你准备好面对生活的真相了吗？在这部BL视觉小说中，带领一名研究生在他最后6个小时（及之后）的贪婪与恐惧之间度过他的生活。

这是“心灵欺骗者”三部曲的第一部分。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2514650/]Steam[/url]]
